channel.title: Planetek Insights
channel.description: Field notes from Planetek LLC on AWS cost engineering, migrations, and GenAI guardrails, written by the engineer who did the work.

item.title: What twelve live AWS environments cost us last month
item.dc:creator: Trevor Lewis
item.description: Twelve production-grade AWS environments plus this website metered $12.23 in AWS usage in July 2026. The cost-engineering rules that keep it there.

item.title: Public GenAI demos that cannot run up the bill
item.dc:creator: Trevor Lewis
item.description: Anyone can use our Bedrock-backed assistant and model workbench, yet the worst-case daily spend was computed before launch. The guardrail stack, layer by layer.

item.title: How to move a small-business website to AWS without breaking your email
item.dc:creator: Trevor Lewis
item.description: The risky part of a website migration is the DNS zone that carries your mail. The order of operations that made our own cutover boring.
